Tankers Hit in Strait of Hormuz Amid Rising Iran Tensions

Two oil tankers were struck by naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz, causing fires and raising concerns about global oil prices and maritime security. One report indicated an Indian crew member is missing following the incidents. The attacks occurred amid heightened tensions between the United States and Iran, with the US reportedly expanding its blockade. While crude oil prices declined due to rising US inventories, the ongoing hostilities in the region limited the drop.
